title: The Beginning After the End Creator Confirms Hiatus After Major Platform Shutdown
content: The future of The Beginning After the End looks bleak after Tapas announced its shutdown in October, 2026. The web novel has been publishing on the platform in 2017 and only a year later, it received a webtoon adaptation.

title: 3 Manga That Fans Ranked Higher Than One Piece in 2026
content: One Piece continued its epic narrative in 2026, yet three other series still managed to rank above it according to fans. Eiichiro Oda’s manga has consistently released new chapters for more than a decade, continuing to engage longtime fans and attract new readers every year.

title: Dragon Ball’s Best Version of Bardock Isn’t the One You Think
content: Bardock, the father of Goku, appeared in numerous Dragon Ball franchise TV anime and movies and had a wide range of personality traits in canon and non-canon outings. It’s time to set the record straight and state that Xenoverse Bardock proved the best blend of all the other characterizations.
